title: Benefits denial
summary: A care worker loses her job while caring for her child and is denied unemployment.
story:
hi, so i got denied for unemployment and i think its wrong but i dont know if theres even anything i can do at this point. im renata, i was a CNA at cedarbrook care center in st paul for almost 6 years, good reviews, i have my little certificates from them and everything. they fired me on may 15 for "attendance." heres the thing, the days i missed in may, that was my daughter zofia, shes 9 and she has type 1 diabetes, she went into DKA which if you dont know is when the blood sugar goes crazy and its life or death, she was IN THE HOSPITAL at childrens may 4 to may 6 and i was at her bed the whole time, and then may 11 she had the follow up appointment. i called the charge nurse line EVERY time before my shift, every single time, thats the rule and i followed it. i missed 3 days in may total and they act like i just didnt show up. their letter also counts some day in march that i literally worked, i have no idea where they got that one, i was there, my coworker delores can say so.

so i applied for unemployment right away like may 17 online, and then i got this determination letter that says im INELIGIBLE because i was "discharged for employment misconduct" because of the attendance thing. the letter is dated may 29. when i read misconduct i just cried honestly, like i was taking care of my sick child, how is that misconduct. the letter has something about appealing but the hr lady at cedarbrook had already told me when they fired me that i could appeal through hr within 10 business days and i didnt do that in time bc zofia had another rough week, so i figured i missed my chance and that was that. also im gonna be honest, after the denial i stopped doing the weekly request thing online bc i figured whats the point if im denied, so i havent logged in in like a month.

today is july 7 and my neighbor who went through something like this said NO, the hr thing and the state thing are different and i should get real help before its too late, so thats why im writing this. i have the determination letter and my termination letter and the hospital papers for zofia. money wise im barely hanging on, im doing doordash but its nothing. is it too late for me? did i already blow it by missing the hr appeal? and if i can still fight it, what do i even say, bc the employer keeps saying "pattern of absenteeism" like im some flake instead of a mom whose kid almost died.

title: Consumer debt
summary: A disputed debt leads to collection and court papers.
story:
ok so i need help because these debt collector people are about to drive me into the ground. company called north star receivables, they been calling me 6 or 7 times a day about an old credit card from meridian bank that i had way back before i got hurt. today is july 8 and just TODAY they already called three times and its not even lunch. they call at 7:15 in the MORNING, they called me at my part time job at lundeen's hardware which my manager was not happy about, and worst one, they called my sister renee and TOLD HER i owe money, like straight up told her the amount and everything, she called me all worried. i keep a little notebook now of every call bc my neighbor said i should.

so the letter came in the mail june 25, its dated june 20, and it says i owe $2,483.17. but the guy on the phone, calls himself "mr. drummond," he keeps saying its $3,100 with the fees, so which is it?? honestly when i stopped paying on that card i think it was more like two grand. and here's the thing, i havent paid a dime on that card since august 2020, thats when i got hurt at the warehouse job and everything fell apart, i been on social security disability since 2021, i get $1,480 a month direct deposit and i do 12 hours a week at the hardware store at $14 to keep busy, thats it, thats everything i live on.

the drummond guy says if i dont set something up they're gonna garnish my wages and freeze my bank account "by the end of the month." he said theres nothing i can do to stop it. that scared me so bad i almost did the thing where he said if i paid $50 "good faith" by july 3 they'd knock 30% off. i didnt do it yet only bc my check was short that week, but he says the offer is still open if i pay this week and honestly im thinking maybe i should just pay the 50 so they leave me alone?? but that 50 is groceries. i never got any court papers or nothing, no lawsuit that i know of, just the letter and the calls. i live over on payne ave in st paul, ramsey county, by myself. i just want the calls to stop and i NEED my disability money safe, if they take that im done. what do i do, should i pay them the 50?

title: Elder exploitation
summary: A family member faces financial exploitation.
story:
I hardly know how to say this because it's about my own son and I feel just sick writing it down. I'm Lorraine, I'm 79, widowed since 2019, I own my little house on Arcade Street in St. Paul, paid off, Frank and I raised the kids there. My son Dale, he's 52, he moved in with me last November after my hip surgery, which at the time I was grateful for, I truly was. In December he had me sign a power of attorney paper, he printed it off the internet, he said it was "so I can handle things while you heal, Ma." I signed it December 8th at the kitchen table. I want to be clear that my mind is fine, it was my hip that was broken, not my head, but I was on the pain pills then and I just signed where he pointed.

Since January my checking account at Prairie Sky Bank has been bleeding out. My pension from Frank's union and my Social Security both go in there. Dale took my debit card "to do the shopping" and never gave it back, and there's cash coming out at the ATM every single week, seven, eight, nine hundred dollars, and I don't see any of it. In February there was a check for $6,400 to a boat place, a BOAT, and there's these transfers to his own account every month that he calls his "caregiver pay" which we never once agreed to. By my figuring it's about $14,000 gone since January. When I finally asked him about the boat on June 14th he grabbed my wrist hard enough to leave a bruise, I took a picture of it with my tablet, and he got in my face and said if I keep asking questions I'll "end up at Ridgeview," that's the nursing home. Since then I'm afraid to say anything in my own house. He yells so much the neighbor asked me about it.

Then two things happened that made me finally call you. The bank sent me a letter dated June 26th saying they flagged unusual activity and want me to come in, and I haven't answered it yet because Dale checks the mail before me and I only got this one because my neighbor Bev grabbed it for me. And second, on July 1st a realtor woman came to the HOUSE, Dale's telling her about listing it, MY house, and there's some appointment on July 16th where I'm apparently supposed to sign listing papers. Today is July 6th. I don't want to put my son in jail, I just want my money to stop disappearing and to keep my house and honestly I don't want to be afraid at my own kitchen table. Can I undo that power of attorney paper? And can somebody make sure whatever happens on the 16th doesn't happen? Bev is helping me send this from her computer so Dale doesn't see.

title: Employment discrimination
summary: Workplace discrimination raises questions about remedies and timing.
story:
i got fired because of my back and i keep going back and forth on whether i even have a case, so here goes. im gideon, 38, i was a picker at tri-state fulfillment in brooklyn park, big warehouse, been there like five years, always hit my numbers, i got the little pins they give you and everything. last winter my disc problems got real bad, herniated disc L4-L5, i have the MRI, and in february my doctor put me on a restriction, no lifting over 35 pounds. most of my job is scanning and picking small bins honestly, the heavy lifting is maybe a couple times an hour, and theres literally a lift-assist machine on the floor and also scanning-station jobs that other guys do all day.

so march 9 i gave HR the doctor's note and asked, real polite, can i get moved to the scan station or use the lift assist for the heavy stuff. they sat on it for almost a month, never really talked to me about options, then april 6 i get an email saying no, lifting up to 50 pounds is an "essential function," and get this, they said the light duty program is ONLY for people who got hurt ON THE JOB. my buddy trevor hurt his shoulder at work last year and they had him on the scan station for four months, so it exists, they just wouldnt give it to me because my injury is from life and not from the warehouse?? they put me on unpaid leave that same day and said if i couldnt come back "full duty" by late may i was done. may 22 the termination letter came. my supervisor derek had also been making comments for months like "we need guys who can hustle, not broken down guys" and after i handed in the note he stopped giving me the good routes. also nobody ever said one word to me about FMLA or gave me any paperwork when they put me on that leave, my cousin says thats a whole thing on its own, i wouldnt know.

now heres what i really need answered fast. on june 30 HR emailed me a "severance agreement," 4 weeks pay, $3,520, but i have to sign by JULY 21 and it says i release all claims, every kind. today is july 10 so ive got like a week and a half and honestly $3,520 is real money to me right now, im behind on my car payment. but signing feels like letting them get away with it. do i have a deadline for filing something with the government about the discrimination? did i already miss it, since the accommodation thing was back in april? and should i sign this severance or is that me giving up everything for a month of pay. i have the denial email, the termination letter, and the severance thing to show you.

title: Family custody
summary: A parent seeks help with custody and family safety.
story:
I don't even know where to start honestly. Ok so back in December Corey and I split up for good, we were never married, we have Miles who's 7 and Ava who just turned 4, and since then it's kind of just been me with them, like 90% of the time he'd get them every other weekend, no paper saying so we just did it that way because we were trying to be adults about it. Anyway on June 15 I got served, like a sheriff's deputy came to my work which was SO embarrassing in front of my manager, and there's this whole packet, Petition to Establish Custody and it says I have 30 days to file a Response or he could get everything he's asking for including he wants full custody, sole, and I'd only get supervised time with my own kids which is insane, I'm a good mom. There's also some court date in July, the packet has an "Initial Case Management Conference" I think July 22, I don't even know what that is, do I have to go, do I need a lawyer, I can't afford one.

Then, ok this is the part I really need help with — on June 28 Corey showed up at my place without texting first while I had the kids, we got into it about the papers, and he grabbed my arm so hard he left a bruise (I have pictures) and he was screaming that if I "tried anything" with the custody case he'd take the kids and I'd "never see them again," Miles was crying in his room the whole time and Ava wouldn't stop asking if daddy was mad at her after. I didn't call the police because I panicked and honestly I was scared it'd make him worse, but he's texted me a bunch since then, kind of threatening stuff, I have all of it saved. My car also needs a new alternator and my sister thinks I should move but I don't want to uproot the kids from their school. I just need to know what to do about the custody papers and whether I even have a real shot at keeping them safe, I feel like nobody's listening to me.

title: Immigration
summary: An immigration situation intersects with work and family concerns.
story:
My name is Marisol but everybody call me Mari. I don't really know where to start because everything happening at same time and I am so scared about the letter that came. Okay, the hearing letter — it came end of June, my cousin Yesenia read it to me because my English not so good with the legal words. It say I have to go to the court at Fort Snelling, August twenty, this year, 2026, nine in the morning, and it say if I don't come they can order me removed without me even being there, "in absentia" is what it say, my cousin had to look up what that even mean.

I came to this country August 14, 2019, cross by the river near Eagle Pass Texas with my son who was five then, I remember the date because is my mother's saint day back home. Immigration catch us the next morning, give me some papers, NTA I think it say, and let me go with the ankle thing for a while, they took it off later. I move to Minnesota because my cousin here in Bloomington. A man, not a lawyer, his name Rigoberto, charge me six hundred dollars, say he file my asylum paper for me, I never got nothing back after, no letter, no number, no receipt even, I ask him many time and he stop answering the phone maybe 2021.

My daughter was born here in Minneapolis 2021, she going into first grade now, that's how I know is been almost seven years since we cross.

I marry my husband Danilo in 2022, he already have his green card ten years now, at first was okay but he start drinking bad maybe two years ago, he hit me first time last year, then again March 15 this year, I call the Bloomington police that night, they arrest him, there was a police report, case number they gave to my cousin, he still in the criminal court process, I don't know when it finish. Officer say I was cooperating good with them.

I also work cleaning houses, a friend give me a social number that's not really mine to get the job, I still working there now, I need the money for my kids, my son still in Honduras with my mother, he's twelve, I miss him so much, I send money every month, also my car transmission broke last month, cost a lot of money to fix. I don't know what to do about the court date, please help me understand what happening to me and my kids.

title: Landlord tenant
summary: A renter faces housing problems and possible eviction.
story:
ok i dont even know where to start this but i got PAPERS taped to my door tonight from the court saying i have to show up april 1st or they can kick us out?? im freaking out. so basically my landlord wendell (krupicka properties, we're in birchcrest terrace unit 4 in otter bend) is saying i didnt pay rent but thats not even true i paid MOST of it i just held back $300 out of the $1200 bc he has been ignoring the mold in our bathroom ceiling since like october and it just keeps getting worse, i have texts from nov 12 and dec 2 where i sent him pics and he just said "probably needs bleach" and "ill get to it when i can, slow season" and then never showed up. my son marcus is 7 and has asthma and hes been coughing so much worse since like december, i really think its the mold but i dont have like a doctor saying that in writing yet.

also ok this part i forgot to mention first but its important — back in january our HEAT went out for like 5 days, jan 18 to 23, it was like 10 degrees outside and marcus was sick and i texted wendell and he just said call the emergency line which NEVER picked up, finally sent a guy jan 23. after that i got so fed up i called the city on feb 20 to report the mold and no-heat thing and someone from the city actually came out feb 25 and i guess wrote him up for it bc i saw the guy's card left in our mailbox. and literally like a week later, march 3rd, thats when the 14 day notice showed up taped to the door saying i owe $350 (300 back rent + 50 late fee) and i have 14 days to pay it all or move out. i didnt pay bc i honestly dont have $350 just laying around and i wanted the mold fixed first tbh.

so now today (march 22) these new court papers say the case is set for april 1st at 9am at halden county court, housing division, and it says nonpayment AND something checked off about "material lease violation" which i have no clue what that even means, i never violated anything?? also side note when we moved in july 2025 he made us pay an extra $500 CASH for having our cat, no receipt or nothing, just handed it to him. our lease actually runs thru june 2026 so its not even like our lease is up, hes trying to just push us out early. i dont want to lose our apartment, i have nowhere else to go with marcus, please help me figure out what to do before april 1st.

title: Wage theft
summary: A construction worker seeks unpaid wages and overtime.
story:
so my boss basically stole my last two paychecks and i dont know what to do about it. i'm junior, i do drywall taping and finishing, been working for rick at vantera drywall since march 2024, jobs all over minneapolis and the suburbs. rick always said im an "independent contractor," he had me sign some paper when i started, but man, HE tells me what job site to be at and what time, he sends the schedule every sunday night, i ride in the company van with his guys, i use his tools and his stilts, i dont have no other customers, i cant even say no to a job or im off the schedule for two weeks. he pays $24 an hour, always straight time even when we do 54, 56 hours a week which was every week this whole spring, no pay stubs ever, just a check with a number on it, sometimes he'd round my hours down and when i asked about it he'd go "thats what the sheet says."

anyway june 19, a friday, i finally asked him on the site about overtime bc my cousin told me after 48 hours they gotta pay time and a half in minnesota. rick got all red and that same night he texts me "dont bother coming monday, im going a different direction." so im fired, fine, but he NEVER PAID ME for the last two weeks i worked, june 8 to june 19, i got my hours in my notebook, 108 hours. on monday june 22 i texted him formal, like my cousin told me to word it, that i demand my wages, all of it. that was more than two weeks ago. today is july 9 and still nothing, he just says "you get paid when the builder pays me" and then "stop texting me or you'll never see a dime." i think he owes me like $2,600 just for those two weeks, plus all that overtime from before that i never got.

also since he says im a contractor i got a 1099 last year and i had to pay all these taxes myself which killed me, and now im not working and i dont even know if i can get unemployment bc of the contractor thing?? i applied anyway last week, we'll see. i got rent due and my wife is pregnant, i need this money not in six months, like now. i still got the texts, the agreement paper, and my notebook with every week's hours wrote down. can i do anything to make him pay fast, and is there something about him firing me right when i asked about the overtime, bc that timing was NOT a coincidence.
